25-5 MULLIN V. AL OTRO LADO
DECISION BELOW: 138 F.4th 1102
CERT. GRANTED 11/17/2025
QUESTION PRESENTED:
The Immigration and Nationality Act, 8 U.S.C. 1101
et seq
. , provides that an alien who
"arrives in the United States" may apply for asylum and must be inspected by an immigration
officer. 8 U.S.C. 1158(b)(1)(A), 1225(a)(1) and (3). The question presented is whether an alien
who is stopped on the Mexican side of the U.S.-Mexico border "arrives in the United States"
within the meaning of those provisions.
LOWER COURT CASE NUMBER: 22-55988, 22-56036
